about: Record of the hand reading (2026-11-03, M2.3, decision 027) of the SFT pool (datasets/soe/v1/sft/pool.jsonl) against Levels A, B, C (docs/reports/m2_contamination_sft.json). Read side by side by the agent: every pair in category E or R or with the same answer, every Level C pair, and every remaining pair with an n-gram share >= 0.5; the user decides. drop = the same problem as the reference (reformatted, reworded, answer re-encoded, a multiple-choice copy, or one part of it); keep = a variant with other data, a different question, or a match on shared answer-format wording. Unread pairs are dropped (user). A pool problem is dropped if any of its pairs says drop. Every pool problem listed in docs/reports/m2_contamination_sft_rl.json is dropped without review (user), and so is every pool problem holding >= 50% of a Level A/B/C problem's 13-grams (the frozen build rule, decision 003), whatever its verdict (user). Ids only. Rounds (decision 027): the check is repeated on the pool left after each round, because removing problems shrinks the boilerplate n-gram set and can list new pairs; a round-k pair is reviewed like a round-1 pair, and every RL-listed problem of every round is dropped, until a round lists only reviewed keeps against Levels A, B, C and nothing against the RL pool. Round 3 is that final check (docs/reports/m2_contamination_sft_clean.json, m2_contamination_sft_rl_clean.json) plus the below-20% read of Level C (docs/reports/m2_contamination_sft_levelc_low.json, 8- and 13-gram share >= 0.1). Record only: under decision 027 as accepted, the cleaner drops every pool problem in any listed pair, whatever its verdict here (user: the 92 keeps are dropped too).
